sahneler.metin: Slush on a runway killed 23 people, including eight Manchester United players.
The plane crashed through a fence and into a house.
It was the pilots' third takeoff attempt.
So why couldn't it get into the air?
Slush at the end of the runway acted like a brake.
The plane lost speed just as it needed it most.
Investigators blamed ice and the captain for years.
He was cleared in 1969: slush, not ice, was the killer.

aciklama:
On February 6, 1958, British European Airways Flight 609 failed to take off from Munich, killing 23 people including eight Manchester United players. Slush on the runway, not wing ice, was later found to be the cause.
